dialogue-with-a-ghostspeak-amulet-equipp.player: Maybe you should try looking on the bright side of...

using-kharedst-s-memoirs-or-book-of-the-.player: Are you the grave digger this entry mentions?

using-kharedst-s-memoirs-or-book-of-the-.npc: It seems likely, but I've no recollection of this conversation.

using-kharedst-s-memoirs-or-book-of-the-.player: That's odd. Did you forget a lot when you...

using-kharedst-s-memoirs-or-book-of-the-.npc: Died? I guess some memories have faded, but my death still lingers within me.
I was minding my own business while digging a grave when suddenly there was a loud metallic sound.
I was dead... I recall seeing a man a few yards from me, speaking out loud, yet nobody else was around...
I thought I could hear a woman's voice respond, but it was likely just the wind.
I wouldn't think on it too long. I'd just died, my emotions were unbearable.

using-kharedst-s-memoirs-or-book-of-the-.player: I'll let you know if I figure anything out. What's your name?

using-kharedst-s-memoirs-or-book-of-the-.npc: Please do. My name? It's um... Sander.

using-kharedst-s-memoirs-or-book-of-the-.player: Pleased to meet you Sander, I'll see you around.
